preToolUse.bash: if [ -z "${COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ]; then exit 0; fi; if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then PY=python3; elif command -v python >/dev/null 2>&1; then PY=python; else exit 0; fi; guard="$COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/copilot-mention-guard.py"; if [ ! -f "$guard" ]; then printf '%s\n' '[copilot-extensions-harness] mention guard unavailable; skipped' >&2; exit 0; fi; if result=$("$PY" "$guard" --wrapped 2>/dev/null); then printf '%s' "$result"; else printf '%s\n' '[copilot-extensions-harness] mention guard unavailable; skipped' >&2; fi; exit 0
preToolUse.powershell: if (-not $env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT) { exit 0 }; $py = $null; foreach ($candidate in @('python3','python','py')) { foreach ($found in $ExecutionContext.SessionState.InvokeCommand.GetCommands($candidate, [System.Management.Automation.CommandTypes]::Application, $false)) { if ($found.Source -notmatch '\\WindowsApps\\') { $py = $found; break } }; if ($py) { break } }; if (-not $py) { exit 0 }; try { $result = & $py.Source (Join-Path $env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT 'scripts\copilot-mention-guard.py') --wrapped 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { $result | Write-Output } else { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('[copilot-extensions-harness] mention guard unavailable; skipped') } } catch { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('[copilot-extensions-harness] mention guard unavailable; skipped') }; exit 0
